scope: Paper identity, claim/population scope and study-design provenance only; no human scientific approval.
identity_check: Every new claim and population inspected against its named source PDF. No adjacent-article contamination found. Two analysis/sample-unit provenance issues held; originals preserved.

quarantined.reason: PDF pp. 3 and 5 describes mass-univariate VLSM and multivariate SCCAN; this record notes SCCAN but labels method=RLSM (region-based lesion-symptom mapping). Reconcile analysis-method provenance before publication.

PDF pp. 6-7 describes a post-hoc weighted analysis of six studies with sex-stratified age information, not a six-participant sample. The draft sample.n=6 conflates studies with patients and method=behavioral_only obscures the pooled-study analysis. Reconcile sample unit and analysis provenance before publication.

source_papers.identity_scope: 55 participants with aphasia after a single left stroke; mean 39.80 months. Semantic Fluency Test and COWAT, VLSM, SCCAN and post-hoc SVR-LSM. Claims checked against Methods pp. 2-3 and Results p. 5. R009 held for incompatible RLSM label.

ALE meta-analysis of 12 studies (105 chronic aphasic patients, 129 healthy controls); inferior-frontal lesion subgroups 65/40 with acknowledged classification approximation. Healthy-control R001 remains explicitly healthy; other claims concern aphasic network recruitment and functional homology. Results pp. 2-4 and discussion pp. 6-7 support named clusters, not direct intervention efficacy.

Reanalysis of 64 left-stroke participants with current or initial aphasia, same cohort as Schwartz2009; mean 68 months, 59/64 >=6 months. Broad SemPlus naming errors, NVcomp and lesion-volume controls, BA21/BA22 sensitivity analyses checked against Methods pp. 3-4 and Results/discussion pp. 6-10. No adjacent article or substituted cohort.

Separate literature meta-analysis and US HCUP/NIS state/year summary-data analysis (2011-2014; 1,967,038 stroke records). Retained R006-R010 are database analyses; age and hemiplegia are aggregate/proxy covariates, not individual follow-up predictions. Interaction is uncorrected p<.05. R004 pooled six-study analysis held for sample-unit/method provenance.
